name: sure
description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
one_liner: A self-hosted personal finance app, like Mint or YNAB, that shows your cashflow and net worth and lets an AI assistant answer questions about your own money.
buyer: A freelancer or small-business owner who wants a self-hosted finance dashboard with AI insight, without handing their bank data to a third-party fintech app.
business_use_cases: A financial coach self-hosts one instance per client and uses the AI assistant to answer 'can I afford this' questions live during coaching sessions.
A privacy-conscious freelancer tracks personal cashflow and net worth without a cloud fintech app mining their bank data.
A small bookkeeping firm offers a 'managed self-hosted finance dashboard' setup as a paid add-on service to clients.

money_ideas.idea: A managed hosting plan for people who like it but don't want to run their own server
A paid setup and bank-sync configuration service for non-technical users

steal_this: Offer a 'we'll set this up and connect your accounts for you' $99 one-off service to friends and local freelancers this weekend.
